pageSubtitle: Upload any learning material, say who it is for, the result you want and the schedule — the mentor plans and teaches it.

newCourse.title: New course
newCourse.subtitle: Tell the agent who the course is for and what result you need. You will upload materials in the next step.

form.title: Course name
form.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. vocational college students, beginner level
form.goals: What learners must be able to do at the end
form.goalsPlaceholder: e.g. work as junior full-stack developers
form.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. teach like a professional developer, with real projects
form.excludedHint: One date per line, YYYY-MM-DD (holidays, breaks).
form.teachingLocaleHint: The mentor talks to each student in their site language.
form.taskTypesHint: Pick the kinds of tasks learners need. If you pick none, the mentor chooses what suits the subject.

documents.title: Teaching materials
documents.subtitle: A file, a link or pasted text. This is the mentor's main source.
documents.tooLarge: The file is larger than 40 MB.
documents.pastedTextPlaceholder: Paste text here: an article, notes, a YouTube transcript...
documents.rulesFiles: Files: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), RTF, PowerPoint (PPTX), Excel (XLSX), CSV, OpenDocument (ODT, ODP, ODS), EPUB, TXT, Markdown, HTML, photos (PNG, JPG, WEBP).
documents.rulesLinks: Links: any public web page, Google Docs / Slides / Sheets / Drive (shared with "anyone with the link"), YouTube (if YouTube blocks the transcript download, paste it as text).
documents.rulesScans: Scanned PDFs and photos are turned into text automatically (max 300 pages per document).
documents.rulesLimits: Limits: 40 MB per file, 20 materials per course.
documents.rulesNot: Not supported: password-protected / private links, DRM-protected e-books, audio and video files without a transcript.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

plan.title: Course plan
plan.subtitle: The agent reads the materials, orders the topics and assigns a lesson to every class day.
plan.confirmRebuild: The current plan and your edits will be replaced. Continue?
plan.needDocuments: Upload at least one document to build the plan.
plan.waitDocuments: Documents are still being processed; you can build the plan in a moment.
plan.progressStructure: The agent is reading the materials and designing modules...
plan.progressHint: This can take a few minutes. You can close the page; planning continues.

detail.subtitle: {{start}} – {{end}} · {{days}} class days · {{minutes}} min
detail.settingsHint: After changing dates or days, build the plan again.
detail.joinCodeHint: Students join the course with this code (the student side arrives in the next stage).

learn.chatPlaceholder: Ask a question or answer the mentor...
